column1: # dev-paths-allow.tsv (harbor#1275) - core code that may name a dev-layer path because it works without it in the export.
# Columns, tab-separated, one header row:  path  dev  reason

#   dev     a dev row of contracts/layers.tsv, or * for every one

# Read by bin/lint-dev-paths.sh; a row without a reason, or naming no dev row, refuses the run. harbor#1275 classifies the
